text: Massah: that is, Temptation | Meribah: That is, Chiding, or, strife
JEHOVAH Nissi: that is, The LORD my banner
Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek: Or, because the hand of Amalek is against the throne of the LORD, therefore etc. Heb. The hand upon the throne of the Lord
